name: Lucky Dragon Hibachi
facts: Lucky Dragon Hibachi is in Compton, California.
Hibachi Catch is a free 30-second game, and no account is needed to play.
Catch food for +10 each. A gold star is +50.
Flames, candy and ice cost −20. Dragon fire costs −30.
Three dragon hits burn your food and end the run.
650+ points in one run earns 15% off your next meal and a spot on the weekly board.
Weekly board: 1st place gets 50% off your next meal and 2nd place gets 20% off.
The board runs Monday through Sunday close and resets every Monday.
The Daily Spin is free, with one spin per member per day, and every slice wins something.
Reward ladder: 250 pts = free extra Yum-Yum, 500 = free fried rice, 800 = free hibachi plate, 1300 = dinner for two.
Spin food prizes are good for 3 days at the Compton location, one reward per visit.
A free account needs your name, phone number and email, with one account per person and per phone.
Players must be 13 or older. Under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.
The app has a language menu with 12 languages.

qa.q: What is the name of this restaurant?
qa.a: Lucky Dragon Hibachi, in Compton, California.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Mon–Thu 11:00a–9:00p, Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p, and Sun 12:00p–8:00p.

qa.q: Are you open today?
qa.a: We're open every day: Mon–Thu 11a–9p, Fri–Sat 11a–10p, Sun 12p–8p. For holiday hours, call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What time do you open on Sunday?
qa.a: Sundays we're open 12:00p to 8:00p.

qa.q: What time do you close on Friday and Saturday?
qa.a: Fridays and Saturdays we close at 10:00p. We open at 11:00a.

qa.q: What time do you close Monday to Thursday?
qa.a: Monday through Thursday we're open 11:00a to 9:00p.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're in Compton, California. The exact street address isn't listed here. Tap Directions in the app to open Google Maps, or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button in the app to open Google Maps for Lucky Dragon Hibachi in Compton.

qa.q: What's the street address?
qa.a: I don't have the full street address. Tap Directions in the app or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please call 562-564-9200 or ask staff.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: Call us at 562-564-9200. There's a Call to order button in the app too.

qa.q: How do I call to order?
qa.a: Tap Call to order in the app, or dial 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How can I see how far I am from you?
qa.a: In the Find us section, tap Show me on the map. It shows how far you are from us, and your location stays on your phone.

qa.q: Do you have Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, we're @luckydragon360. Our latest posts and reels show right in the app.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Hibachi Grill: Hibachi Chicken, Hibachi Steak, Hibachi Shrimp, Chicken + Shrimp Combo, and Premium Lobster. Sides & Extras: Fried Rice, Noodles, and Extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: How much is the Hibachi Chicken?
qa.a: The app shows $12.95: grilled chicken, fried rice, veggies and house yum-yum. Prices in the app may change, so check with staff.

qa.q: How much is the Hibachi Steak?
qa.a: The app shows $15.95: sirloin, fried rice, veggies and double yum-yum. Check with staff for current prices.

qa.q: How much is the Hibachi Shrimp?
qa.a: The app shows $14.95: jumbo shrimp, fried rice and veggies. Check with staff for current prices.

qa.q: What's the Chicken + Shrimp Combo?
qa.a: It's chicken and shrimp together, shown at $16.95 in the app. It's the one from the review video.

qa.q: How much is the lobster?
qa.a: Premium Lobster is market price (MP). It's grilled hibachi style and you can add it to any meal.

qa.q: What sides do you have?
qa.a: Fried Rice (solo, wok-fired with egg and scallion), Noodles (garlic butter hibachi noodles), and Extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: How much is fried rice?
qa.a: Solo Fried Rice is shown at $6.50 in the app.

qa.q: How much are the noodles?
qa.a: Garlic butter hibachi noodles are shown at $6.95.

qa.q: How much is extra Yum-Yum sauce?
qa.a: Extra Yum-Yum is shown at $1.00.

qa.q: Are the menu prices final?
qa.a: The app lists prices, but they may change. Confirm with staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Can I build my own plate?
qa.a: Yes. Use Build your hibachi plate in the app. Pick a base (fried rice, chow mein or half & half), add proteins and extras, then tap Fire it on the grill and place your order.

qa.q: What proteins can I add when building a plate?
qa.a: Chicken, steak, shrimp (up to 2 each), plus salmon and scallops (1 each). Hibachi veggies are free to add.

qa.q: How much do the build-your-plate items cost?
qa.a: Bases: fried rice $6.50, chow mein $6.95, half & half $7.50. Proteins: chicken $6.45, steak $9.45, shrimp $8.45, salmon $9.95, scallops $10.95. Veggies are free and Yum-yum is $1 each.

qa.q: Can I order from my table?
qa.a: You can build your plate in the app and place the order. I don't have more detail on table ordering, so ask staff.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Ask staff at the counter or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Do you do takeout?
qa.a: You can call 562-564-9200 to order. I don't have more detail on takeout or delivery, so ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian options?
qa.a: The menu has hibachi veggies and fried rice or noodles, but I don't have dietary details. Ask staff about ingredients.

qa.q: Do you serve drinks?
qa.a: The game shows drinks, but no drink menu is listed in the app. Ask staff what's available.

qa.q: What is the game?
qa.a: Hibachi Catch is a free 30-second catching game. Slide your tray to catch hibachi food and dodge the dragon's fire.

qa.q: How do I play Hibachi Catch?
qa.a: Tap to start, then slide your finger across the game to move the tray. Catch the food, dodge flames, candy and ice, and keep out of the dragon's fire.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: 30 seconds, unless the dragon burns your food first.

qa.q: Does the game cost anything?
qa.a: No. It's free to play, as often as you like. No purchase is needed to play or win.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. You can play right away. You only need a free member account to save your score or claim a prize after a run.

qa.q: How many times can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free.

qa.q: What do I catch in the game?
qa.a: Chicken, steak, shrimp, lobster, veggies, chow mein, fried rice and drinks are worth +10 each. A rare gold star is worth +50.

qa.q: How does scoring work in the game?
qa.a: Each food catch is +10 plus a streak bonus. A gold star is +50. Flame, candy and ice are −20 each. Dragon fire is −30.

qa.q: What is the streak bonus?
qa.a: Catch food in a row without a miss and you get +2 extra per catch in a row, up to +10 extra. With a streak of 5 or more, each catch is worth +20.

qa.q: What is the gold star?
qa.a: A rare gold star is worth +50 and keeps your streak going.

qa.q: What should I dodge?
qa.a: Flames, candy and ice. Each costs −20 and resets your streak. Also avoid the dragon's fire.

qa.q: What does the dragon do?
qa.a: The Lucky Dragon locks onto your tray with a dashed red line, then breathes fire. Move out of the way. A hit costs −30 and resets your streak.

qa.q: What happens if the dragon hits me three times?
qa.a: Your food is burnt and the run is over.

qa.q: Why does my rice change color?
qa.a: Each dragon hit crisps your rice darker: light brown, then dark brown, then burnt on the third hit.

qa.q: What is the lantern in the game?
qa.a: Once per run a paper lantern drifts down. Catch it on your tray for a +300 bonus. After your run you can watch Antidote The Foodie's review.

qa.q: What is the halftime video?
qa.a: After about 85–95 seconds of total play, your next run opens with a short break of Antidote The Foodie's review clips. You can skip it, watch the full review on YouTube, or go back to the game.

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. If your browser supports it, use the stick or D-pad to slide the tray left and right.

qa.q: How do I win a prize in the game?
qa.a: Score 650 or more in one run for 15% off your next meal and a spot on the weekly board. The top scores of the week win bigger discounts.

qa.q: What do I need to score to make the board?
qa.a: 650 points or more in one run.

qa.q: How does the weekly board work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins. The board resets every Monday, and ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: What does the weekly winner get?
qa.a: 1st place gets 50% off their next meal and 2nd place gets 20% off. These are the prizes shown in the app.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday. It runs Monday through Sunday close.

qa.q: How do I claim my prize?
qa.a: Save your score with a free member account after your run. Winners may be asked to show their code on their phone and a matching account at the counter.

qa.q: Can cheating get me disqualified?
qa.a: Yes. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Is the game a game of luck?
qa.a: No, it's a game of skill. Prizes depend only on your score and where it ranks on the weekly board.

qa.q: Do employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members may play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once per day as a member. Every slice wins something.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: Once per member per day, by Los Angeles time.

qa.q: Does the spin cost anything?
qa.a: No. It's always free. Spins are never sold and can't be earned by buying anything.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50 pts (30%), +100 pts (20%), +75 pts (15%), $2 off a hibachi plate (15%), free extra Yum-Yum sauce (8%), free side of fried rice (7%), or 10% off your order (5%).

qa.q: How long are spin food prizes good for?
qa.a: 3 days at our Compton location, one reward per visit. They can't be combined with other rewards, have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Does the spin give alcohol?
qa.a: No. No prize includes alcohol.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards club?
qa.a: Sign up for a free member account with your name, phone number and email. Join anytime from the app, or after a game run to save your score.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: The app offers a Free Extra Yum-Yum plus 10% off your next plate.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes, a member account is free.

qa.q: Who can join?
qa.a: Legal residents of the United States who are 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free account per person and per phone.

qa.q: Why do you need my phone number?
qa.a: Your account is tied to the phone it was made on. The live app confirms your number with a text code.

qa.q: How do points work?
qa.a: Points come from the Daily Spin and from purchases. They go into your Lucky Dragon Hibachi Rewards account, and you can trade them for rewards. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have a points-per-dollar number. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How many points do I get for playing the game?
qa.a: The game doesn't give points. It gives scores that can win discounts on the weekly board. Points come from the Daily Spin and purchases.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 250 pts: free extra Yum-Yum. 500 pts: free fried rice. 800 pts: free hibachi plate. 1300 pts: dinner for two.

qa.q: How much for a free hibachi plate?
qa.a: 800 points.

qa.q: How much for dinner for two?
qa.a: 1300 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem my points?
qa.a: Use the rewards card in the app and show your code at the counter. Ask staff if you need help.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have levels for Lucky Dragon. Your points unlock the reward steps (250, 500, 800 and 1300).

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: I don't have birthday details. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Can I refer friends?
qa.a: Yes. The referral gift is a free fried rice. Ask staff how it works for you.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for being nearby?
qa.a: When you're near, the app can offer: show it at the counter for double stars on today's order. Turn on location to see it.

qa.q: Do I get points for a Google review?
qa.a: No. We don't give points or prizes for reviews. Honest reviews are welcome, and the app has a button to write one on Google.

qa.q: Do you have specials?
qa.a: Holiday and seasonal specials show up in the app when they're running. Call 562-564-9200 for today's specials.

qa.q: Is there a happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have happy hour details. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the 🌐 language menu for English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย and Русский.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: There's no kid mode. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission to join.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use Add to Home Screen. On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the browser menu then Add to Home screen or Install.

qa.q: Can I get texts and emails from you?
qa.a: Only if you opt in. You can stop them any time by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: Is my information safe?
qa.a: Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: Who do I ask for help?
qa.a: Ask any staff member, or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Do I have to buy food to win?
qa.a: No. No purchase or payment is needed to play Hibachi Catch, spin the daily wheel or win a prize. Buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Where can I read the official rules?
qa.a: The Game & daily spin official rules link in the app has them. Questions can go to 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation info. Call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Do you have game tokens?
qa.a: Tokens are currently off, and the game is free to play.
